the terrestrial biosphere is very sensitive to climatic changes and that the impact of climatic changes on the biospheric carbon cycle and trace gases emissions is significant and should be taken into account in global climate studies.

the geographical distribution of the terrestrial vegetation and the biospheric activity is very sensitive to climatic changes, with a strong decrease in the biospheric carbon cycle during glacial periods.

(1) the biosphere is highly sensitive to climate change, with a large impact on the carbon and trace gases cycles, (2) the biospheric response to climate change depends on the climate forcing and on its spatial distribution and, (3) the geographical distribution of the biospheric carbon pools and flux is highly sensitive to climatic change, and this is a crucial factor in the biospheric response.
